definitions.explanation: Reluctant to spend money, even in situations where spending would be normal or expected.
Engaging in petty behavior to gain small advantages, often in ways that are seen as underhanded or beneath one's dignity.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの{人|ひと}→あの人：25922_anohito⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧せこい。
せこいこと⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧な。

⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧せこい⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{割|わ}り{勘|かん}→割り勘：08156_warikan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧1⟦{円|えん}→円：00774_en⟧⟦{単位|たんい}→単位：03412_tani⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{計算|けいさん}する→計算する：25526_keisansuru⟧。
examples.english: He's so stingy that even when splitting the bill, he calculates down to the last yen.

examples.japanese: せこい⟦{手段|しゅだん}→手段：03219_shudan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{勝|か}って→勝つ：01199_katsu⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{嬉|うれ}しくない→嬉しい：00822_ureshii⟧。
examples.english: Winning through petty means doesn't make me happy.

examples.japanese: ⟦そんな→そんな：01645_sonna⟧せこいこと⟦{言|い}わないで→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦よ→よ：09475_yo⟧。
examples.english: Don't be so petty about it.

examples.japanese: ⟦ポイント→ポイント：11283_pointo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{多|おお}く→多い：01127_ooi⟧⟦もらおう→もらう：00520_morau⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、せこい{買|か}い{方|かた}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧しまう。
examples.english: I end up shopping in petty ways to get even a few more reward points.

notes:
FORMS:
- せこい (plain)
- せこく (adverbial)
- せこさ (noun) - stinginess, pettiness

REGISTER:
Informal/colloquial. Can be mildly insulting when used to describe someone directly.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦けち→けち：02792_kechi⟧ - stingy, miserly (stronger criticism)
- ⟦{貧乏|びんぼう}→貧乏：19466_binbou⟧くさい - looking poor, cheap
- ⟦こすい→こすい：07848_kosui⟧ - cunning, crafty (regional/colloquial)
- みみっちい - petty, stingy
- ⟦{気前|きまえ}がいい→気前がいい：20378_kimaegaii⟧ - generous
- ⟦{太|ふと}っ{腹|ぱら}→太っ腹：15692_futoppara⟧ - generous, big-hearted

USAGE:
Originally from Kansai dialect but now widely used throughout Japan. Often used to criticize not just financial stinginess but also petty behavior in general.
